title: Y2K Polygon
description: Graphismes 3D de consoles de sixième génération du début des années 2000, caractérisés par une géométrie low-poly et des bords crénelés. Les textures sont en basse résolution avec des éclairages et des ombres pré-calculés, sans anticrénelage moderne ni illumination dynamique.
description_en: Early 2000s 6th-generation console 3D graphics featuring low-polygon geometry and strictly aliased, jagged edges. Textures are low-resolution with baked-in lighting and shadows, lacking modern anti-aliasing or dynamic illumination.
description_fr: Graphismes 3D de consoles de sixième génération du début des années 2000, caractérisés par une géométrie low-poly et des bords crénelés. Les textures sont en basse résolution avec des éclairages et des ombres pré-calculés, sans anticrénelage moderne ni illumination dynamique.
prompt: Late 1990s to early 2000s retro 3D video game graphics, mimicking a 6th-generation console real-time rendering engine. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The visual execution relies heavily on low-polygon geometry, resulting in blocky structural forms, sharp angular intersections, and a distinct lack of smooth organic curves. Crucially, there is zero anti-aliasing; all geometric boundaries and silhouettes feature harsh, jagged, stair-step aliased edges. Surfaces are wrapped in low-resolution texture maps that exhibit visible point filtering, noticeable pixelation, and subtle compression artifacts. Lighting is entirely static and flat, characterized by baked-in illumination where shadows, fabric folds, and fake specular highlights are painted directly onto the 2D texture maps rather than being dynamically calculated by the engine. There is no ambient occlusion or global illumination. The color palette reflects early digital realism, utilizing {{primary_color}} as the foundational tone, punctuated by flatly mapped areas of {{accent_color}}, and supported by {{secondary_color}} in the environmental mapping. Materials appear rigid and cardboard-like, lacking subsurface scattering or complex shaders. The depth of field is infinite, with no bloom, lens flare, or modern post-processing, relying purely on basic Z-buffer depth. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners.

video.motion: Animations must be rigid and vertex-weighted, mimicking early motion capture with slightly stiff, linear interpolations between keyframes. Objects should rotate or translate with a mechanical, unpolished clunkiness typical of vintage game engines.
video.camera: The camera should pan or orbit on a fixed, rigid track, avoiding any handheld shake, maintaining a steady, mathematical trajectory.
video.temporal_texture: Textures must suffer from slight affine texture mapping warping (texture swimming) during camera movement, while the aliased jagged edges crawl and shimmer consistently.
video.avoid: Avoid smooth motion blur, fluid dynamics, soft dynamic shadows, modern anti-aliasing, and high-framerate interpolations that break the retro 30fps illusion.
